name: large_perc_long
_purpose: Longer, higher-LR perceptual training from the large checkpoint. The shipped fine-tune was deliberately gentle (25 epochs, lr 5e-5) and cost 0.34 dB PSNR (29.016 -> 28.676) to reach LPIPS 0.1811. At lr 1e-4 over 40 epochs the network can reorganise rather than merely adjust, which may hold the LPIPS gain while recovering some PSNR.
_one_variable: Only lr and epochs differ from large_ft_perceptual.json. lpips_weight stays 0.10 so the comparison isolates schedule length, not loss weighting.
_ship_rule: Ship only if it beats the current model (28.676 / 0.7543 / 0.1811) on PSNR and SSIM WITHOUT losing LPIPS, or improves all three. A trade is not an upgrade -- we already have the best trade.
